As Blackstone Group LP (BX) Shares Declined, Atlanta Capital Group Has Lifted Position by $322,080; Schwerin Boyle Capital Management Lifted Bank Of America (BAC) Stake by $6.80 Million as Market Value Declined
May 17, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Schwerin Boyle Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Bank Of America (BAC) by 16.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Schwerin Boyle Capital Management Inc bought 234,489 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.20% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.65 million shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $48.61 million, up from 1.41 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Schwerin Boyle Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Bank Of America for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $313.78 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.37% or $0.11 during the last trading session, reaching $30.95. About 16.34M shares traded. Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) has risen 28.18% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.63% the S&P500.
Atlanta Capital Group increased its stake in Blackstone Group LP (BX) by 54.09% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 28,672 shares of the investment managers company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $918,000, up from 18,607 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
